div.head: Ger 8[b]
div.ab: [8[b]] huru is mæst neod, þæt he asece, hu he yrde mæge fyrme geforðian, ðonne ðæs tima sy.
Huru is mæst neod þæt he asece hu he yrde mæge fyrme geforðian ðonne ðæs tima sy.
Huru is mæst neod þæt he asece hu he yrde mæge fyrme geforðian ðonne ðæs tima sy.
namentlich ist zumeist nöthig, dass er erforsche, wie er den Boden durch Bearbeitung fördern könne, wenn der Zeitpunkt dafür ist.
above all it is most necessary that he find out how he can further the land by tillage, when the time for it comes.
At the least, it is most desirable that he learns how he may cultivate the land [and] what he should do when it is the right time.
In particular, it is most necessary that he learn how to cultivate the earth when it is time.
div.note: Liebermann asks whether the author means ‘yrðe’ as ‘ploughing’, as in 10. Compare 1 f.

note.seg: does the author mean yrðe, ploughing, as in 10?

On the miswriting yrde [‘the estate by tillage’ Sk-Wi, wrong] for yrðe cf. forðsit, dingan (Rect 4, 3c. 14) for -ið, ði-; better translation: ‘er das Pflügen durch’
